The Wasatch Front Regional Council (WFRC) is a public agency. This site and the tools on it are published for public use, and WFRC does not attach a license or fee to the text, charts, maps and apps its Analytics team produces. Data from other organizations is different: it keeps its original copyright and terms.

## Material made by WFRC Analytics

You may read, share, link to and build on the pages, charts, maps and apps that WFRC Analytics created. There is no license to request and no fee. Because WFRC is a public agency, its data and methods must not be misrepresented, so reuse comes with three conditions:

1. **Credit the work and link to the source.** Each tool page gives a suggested citation, for example: *Wasatch Front Regional Council. (2026). Commute Patterns Map [Online tool]. https://wfrc.utah.gov/maps/regional-commuter-flows/*

2. **If you modify, adapt or build on our work, you must say clearly what you changed.** Describe the changes to the data, the method, the settings or the presentation, and name who made them. A changed version must never be presented as WFRC's own. For example: *"Based on WFRC's Commute Patterns Map (2026). Modified by [organization]: [what changed]."*

3. **Do not imply that WFRC endorses your version, your conclusions or your product.** Do not use the WFRC name or logo in a way that suggests it does.

These conditions apply to results from our tools and models as well as to the pages and maps themselves.

## Data from other sources

Many tools combine WFRC's work with data from other organizations. **That data keeps its original copyright and terms, and you must follow them if you reuse it.** Check the provider before you republish, redistribute or build a product on it.

| Source | Used for |
|---|---|
| [U.S. Census Bureau](https://www.census.gov/) | Commuting flows (LEHD LODES), American Community Survey estimates, TIGER/Line boundaries |
| [Utah Geospatial Resource Center (UGRC)](https://gis.utah.gov/) | Roads, trails and other statewide layers |
| [Utah Department of Transportation (UDOT)](https://www.udot.utah.gov/) | Traffic counts and roadway data |
| [Utah Transit Authority (UTA)](https://www.rideuta.com/) | Transit ridership and routes |
| [Kem C. Gardner Policy Institute](https://gardner.utah.edu/) | Population, household and employment projections |
| [Utah Department of Workforce Services](https://jobs.utah.gov/) | Employment data |
| Commercial mobility datasets, such as StreetLight and Locus | Origin-destination estimates in some analyses; the provider's terms may apply |
| Map basemaps, such as OpenStreetMap contributors, CARTO and Esri | The maps in our apps; their credits appear on each map |

## Models

The Travel Demand Model and other models are shared by request, under the release letter described in [Get the model](../models/get-the-model.qmd). Please follow it, including not passing the model on.

## Source code

The source code for many tools is in the [WFRC Analytics GitHub organization](https://github.com/WFRCAnalytics){target="_blank"}. Most repositories do not include a separate license file. Libraries and data used inside them keep their own licenses and terms.

## No warranty

Tools and data are provided in good faith as best-effort planning products. You are responsible for how you apply them and interpret their results.

## Questions

If you are unsure whether you may reuse something, [contact the team](../contact/index.qmd).
